description: This file defines a Flutter widget called BoardView, which visually represents a chessboard and handles user interaction such as tapping on squares. It constructs a visual grid with rank and file labels, piece symbols, and highlights for selected squares. The widget uses theming and animations to enhance the UI.

classes.name: BoardView
classes.description: A stateless Flutter widget that displays a chessboard with pieces, highlights, and interaction handling.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for rendering the chessboard UI.

methods.name: _blend
methods.description: Helper method to blend two colors based on overlay alpha for highlight effects.
